# Copilot Instructions for Anvil

This file provides guidance to GitHub Copilot when working with code in this
repository.

> **Anvil**: Deterministic development automation platform that makes
> AI-generated code changes safe for production.

## Primary Instructions

**See `AGENTS.md` in the repository root for complete project documentation**,
including:

- Planning work requirements (read `plans/aps-rules.md` first)
- Essential commands (`pnpm build`, `pnpm test`, etc.)
- Project structure and where to look
- Conventions (UK English, ESM .js extensions, Zod schemas)
- Anti-patterns to avoid
- Common workflows
- Architecture and design principles
- Testing patterns
